description: This file defines the DateRange class within the OrangeHRM project, representing a date range with optional start and end dates, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating a date range with optional start and end dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DateRange instance with optional from and to DateTime objects.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of the range.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of the range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date of the range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date of the range.
